workspace.name: EVD-0010 暫定Active Skill 80件・職業別装備可能対応表

project_context.purpose: EVD-0009に登録された暫定Active Skill 80件について、EVD-0001のPlayer全7職Lv1～50期待Statsを用い、各SkillのStat Thresholdを満たして装備可能になる職業と最低Lvを固定Evidenceとして保存する。
project_context.summary: 80 Skill × 7職 = 560組を全件照合。各Skillごとに装備可能職業、最低装備可能Lv、最低Lv時点の必要Stat実値、Lv1～50内では装備不可の職業を保持する。Battle/Simulationは実行しない。

current_focus.theme: EVD-0010 Skill装備可能職業・最低Lv対応表
current_focus.goal: 後続の実戦Balance Testで、Skillを実際に装備できるPlayer Characterだけを合法な測定主体として選別できるEvidenceを登録する。

source_baseline.source_role: Inherited Fresh Current baseline from EVD-0009

history.message: Created EVD-0010 by joining EVD-0009 provisional Skill stat thresholds against EVD-0001 Player expected Stats for all 7 jobs and Lv1-50. No Source/Game Data modification and no Battle/Simulation execution.

authority_basis.equipability_rule: For a Skill, a Player job/level is equipable when every stat in skill.stat_thresholds is greater than or equal to the required threshold. The minimum qualifying level within Lv1..50 is recorded.
authority_basis.job_restriction_rule: No separate Job restriction is applied. Eligibility is determined only from the Skill stat_thresholds recorded in EVD-0009 and Player expected_stats in EVD-0001.
authority_basis.level_range_rule: Search only Lv1..50 because EVD-0001 authority scope is Lv1..50. If no qualifying level exists in this range, record as not equipable within Lv1..50.
authority_basis.evidence_boundary: This Evidence establishes stat-threshold equipability only. It does not prove Formal Skill Master registration, runtime execution validity, equipment-tag useRequirements, Skill acquisition availability timing beyond stat thresholds, or combat balance.
authority_basis.human_review: Human instructed creation and registration data output of a job-by-job Skill equipability correspondence table in Evidence format.
